{{nihongo|'''Kitashita Shrine'''|岐多志太神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinai Shōsha}}, and its former rank was village shrine.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The following two deities are enshrined.
*{{ill|Ame-no-Kaguyama|ja|天香山命|zh|天香山命|qid=Q10940849}}
*{{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}

According to shrine tradition, {{ill|Ame-no-Kaguyama|ja|天香山命|zh|天香山命|qid=Q10940849}} is identified with Ishikoridome-no-Mikoto, and together with {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}} enshrines the same deities as {{ill|Kagamitsukuri Nimasu Amateru Mitama Shrine|Q38278496|qid=Q38278496}}. The shrine name "Kitashita" means "the field of the Kita clan," and is interpreted as a deity of metalworkers who forged "kita" (iron). Among the Mononobe Ōki no Muraji clan based in this region, there was the '''Kitashi no Muraji''' (forging lineage), ancestors of the Kagamitsukuri no Muraji, and this shrine is said to have been the one they ritually served.

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, it was enshrined in the 7th year of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|ar|الإمبراطور سوجين|arz|الامبراطور سوجين|azb|سوجین (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Sujin|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سوجین|cs|Sudžin|de|Sujin|el|Αυτοκράτορας Σουτζίν|es|Sujin Tennō|fa|امپراتور سوجین|fr|Sujin|hr|Sujin|id|Kaisar Sujin|it|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇|ka|სუძინი|ko|스진 천황|ms|Maharaja Sujin|nl|Sujin|pl|Sujin|pt|Sujin|ru|Император Судзин|sh|Car Sujin|simple|Emperor Sujin|sl|Cesar Sudžin|sr|Суџин|sv|Sujin|th|จักรพรรดิซูจิง|tl|Emperador Sujin|tr|Sujin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Судзін|uz|Imperator Sujin|vi|Thiên hoàng Sujin|yo|Emperor Sujin|zh|崇神天皇|zh_classical|崇神天皇|zh_min_nan|Suzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|崇神天皇|qid=Q333530}}. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, it was listed as a minor shrine of Jōge District.
